checks.name: Tiled JSON structure, IDs, GIDs, layers and supported geometry
Immutable original asset hashes match inventory

detail.note: Editor session state is volatile and is not an immutable graphical asset. Original inventory hashes are preserved; this check never restores user editor state.

checks.name: Image metadata, referenced paths and nonempty tile pixels
Routes, obstacles and gameplay target reachability

detail.method: Four-neighbour flood fill; every 16px cell intersecting a collision rectangle is blocked

body.guarantee: Clear cardinal center-to-center routes; arbitrary movement or a different runtime collision body must be checked separately

warnings.name: Volatile Tiled editor session metadata
warnings.message: Tiled session metadata changed since inventory, during editor verification or concurrent editor activity. The exact writer cannot be established from hashes alone; images, map and project are checked separately.

visualReview.note: Validation is structural. render-world.mjs produces a CPU reference render; this report does not claim the map was opened in Tiled or Phaser.

runtimeScope: Map data only. The existing application is unchanged; object collisions, interactions and NPC behaviour need explicit runtime integration.
